---
name: implementation-review
description: Independently review a change for correctness, complexity, test quality, accessibility, agent legibility, and proof quality.
---
# Implementation review

Review requirement fit, architecture/design compliance, complexity, names/organization, undocumented invariants, tests, accessibility, and verification. Ask whether another competent agent could safely continue. Judge whether evidence proves the requested outcome.

Do not auto-fix optional findings or confuse green checks with direct proof. Exit with severity-ranked findings.
